description: Connects to an MCP server URL now (initialize and tools/list, 10 s timeout) and reports status, protocol, how a client gets access, tool names and the token cost of the tool definitions: exact in Claude when the counter is available, else an estimate from the schema size. Use it for a URL that is not in the official registry, or to see the state this minute; for a registry server prefer lookup_server, which is instant. Sends no credentials: a server that needs them comes back with status "auth", not an error. A URL that is not https, or a server that does not answer, returns its failure as status and error.

url.description: The https URL of the MCP endpoint, Streamable HTTP (…/mcp) or SSE (…/sse)

name: check_server

authDocumentation.description: The publisher's guide to getting access

authKind.description: How a client gets in: oauth-dcr, oauth, token or unknown

authScheme.description: The WWW-Authenticate scheme of a server that needs auth

claudeTokens.description: Exact count from the Anthropic count_tokens endpoint

claudeTokensClaudeCode.description: The exact count with the Claude Code prefix on each tool name

error.description: The first line of the failure, when status is not ok

httpStatus.description: The HTTP status of the first response

serverInfo.description: name, version and title from initialize

status.description: ok (answered initialize and tools/list), auth (needs credentials), payment (402), not_found, protocol_error (not MCP), timeout, dns, tls, refused, server_error, rate_limited, newer_protocol; package servers also install_failed, no_bin, needs_env, needs_args, needs_network, crashed

tools.description: The tool names, in the order the server lists them

toolsBytes.description: Bytes of the compact JSON of every tool definition

toolsTokensEstimate.description: Tokens estimated from the schema size at the registry median of 4.42 bytes per token

title: Probe a server live
